mapper.select: select id, user_id, provider, identifier, password_hash, verified_at, created_at, updated_at from cm_auth_identities where id = #{id} limit 1
select id, account_name, avatar_url, preferred_locale, status, created_at, updated_at from cm_users where id = #{id} limit 1

select id, user_id, plan_id, tier, status, started_at, expires_at, created_at, updated_at from cm_user_memberships where user_id = #{userId} and status = 'active' and (expires_at is null or expires_at > now()) order by started_at desc limit 1
mapper.update: update cm_users set status = 'active' where id = #{id} and status = 'deactivated'
mapper.insert: insert into cm_users (id, account_name, avatar_url, preferred_locale, status) values (#{id}, #{accountName}, '', #{preferredLocale}, 'active')
insert into cm_auth_identities (id, user_id, provider, identifier, password_hash, verified_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{provider}, #{identifier}, #{passwordHash}, now())
insert into cm_user_security_settings (id, user_id, mfa_enabled) values (#{id}, #{userId}, 0)
insert into cm_user_preferences (id, user_id, preferred_contact_channel) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{preferredContactChannel})

insert into cm_user_memberships (id, user_id, plan_id, tier, status, started_at) select #{id}, #{userId}, id, tier, 'active', now() from cm_membership_plans where tier = 'free' and is_active = 1 limit 1
mapper.update: update cm_users set account_name = #{accountName}, avatar_url = #{avatarUrl}, preferred_locale = #{preferredLocale}, updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
update cm_users set status = 'deactivated', updated_at = now() where id = #{id}
mapper.select: select id, user_id, provider, identifier, password_hash, verified_at, created_at, updated_at from cm_auth_identities where user_id = #{userId}
select count(1) from cm_auth_identities where user_id = #{userId}
select mfa_enabled as mfaEnabled, mfa_method as mfaMethod, mfa_identity_id as mfaIdentityId, mfa_enabled_at as mfaEnabledAt from cm_user_security_settings where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.update: update cm_user_security_settings set mfa_enabled = #{mfaEnabled}, mfa_method = #{mfaMethod}, mfa_identity_id = #{mfaIdentityId}, mfa_enabled_at = case when #{mfaEnabled} then now() else mfa_enabled_at end, updated_at = now() where user_id = #{userId}
mapper.select: select preferred_city_code as preferredCity, preferred_contact_channel as preferredContactChannel, staff_contact_enabled as staffContactEnabled, family_assist_enabled as familyAssistEnabled, introduction_updates_enabled as introductionUpdatesEnabled, event_reminders_enabled as eventRemindersEnabled, service_announcements_enabled as serviceAnnouncementsEnabled, marketing_emails_enabled as marketingEmailsEnabled, analytics_consent_enabled as analyticsConsentEnabled from cm_user_preferences where user_id = #{userId} limit 1
mapper.insert: insert into cm_user_preferences ( id, user_id, preferred_city_code, preferred_contact_channel, staff_contact_enabled, family_assist_enabled, introduction_updates_enabled, event_reminders_enabled, service_announcements_enabled, marketing_emails_enabled, analytics_consent_enabled, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{preferredCity}, #{preferredContactChannel}, #{staffContactEnabled}, #{familyAssistEnabled}, #{introductionUpdatesEnabled}, #{eventRemindersEnabled}, #{serviceAnnouncementsEnabled}, #{marketingEmailsEnabled}, #{analyticsConsentEnabled}, now(), now() ) on duplicate key update preferred_city_code = values(preferred_city_code), preferred_contact_channel = values(preferred_contact_channel), staff_contact_enabled = values(staff_contact_enabled), family_assist_enabled = values(family_assist_enabled), introduction_updates_enabled = values(introduction_updates_enabled), event_reminders_enabled = values(event_reminders_enabled), service_announcements_enabled = values(service_announcements_enabled), marketing_emails_enabled = values(marketing_emails_enabled), analytics_consent_enabled = values(analytics_consent_enabled), updated_at = now()

insert into cm_user_security_challenges ( id, user_id, action, method, identity_id, status, challenge_token, expires_at, created_at, updated_at ) values ( #{id}, #{userId}, #{action}, #{method}, #{identityId}, 'pending', null, #{expiresAt}, now(), now() )
mapper.update: update cm_user_security_challenges set status = 'verified', challenge_token = #{challengeToken}, expires_at = #{expiresAt}, verified_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{id} and status = 'pending' and expires_at > now()
update cm_user_security_challenges set status = 'expired', updated_at = now() where status in ('pending', 'verified') and expires_at <= now() order by expires_at, id limit #{batchSize}
mapper.select: select count(1) from cm_user_security_challenges where status = 'verified' and challenge_token is not null and expires_at > now()
